svg.title: STC-05 · One theme. Three volumes.
svg.desc: The Stagehand intensity dial: Full for creative and community work, Tempered for editorial and civic work, Boardroom for B2B intelligence and the BHIL default. Each level shows what stays, what goes and its timing, with a TX-01 VECTOR GRID specimen at that level and the reel engine multipliers for bloom, rays, halo, chroma, lens dirt, grain and persistence.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V5 · FIG STC-05
Intensity is set once per property from its register. The theme keeps its identity; only the volume changes.
Everything on the card: glitch, chroma split, stutter,
Palette, type trio, transition grammar, the S1
Glitch, chroma and stutter cut to accents of 150 ms
or less, one per section. Saturation down 20%. No
Palette darkened or neutralized, type trio, one
transition grammar, the S1 at low contrast.
All glitch, flicker, stutter, chroma split and stepped
One chapter may step up one level for a deliberate beat, declared in the manifest. The dial never loosens a hard gate.
BHIL · STAGEHAND THEME CODEX · FIG STC-05
